The '''Beast Warrior Commandos''' were a faction of the [[Beast Riders]], warriors from the wilderness of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. During the [[Beast Wars]], they were tasked by [[Modon Kira]] with the [[Raid on the Iziz Royal Palace|abduction]] of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Galia]] in the [[Iziz Royal Palace]]. The Commandos also fought under the banner of Modon's son [[Oron Kira]] against Galia's mother, [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Amanoa]] in the [[Battle of Iziz]]. [[3998 BBY|Two years later]], the Beast Warrior Commandos again fought under Oron Kira, this time against Galia's father [[Ommin/Legends|Ommin]] in what was known as the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising]]. [[3996 BBY|Two years]] after that, the Commandos would see action again against the armies of [[Mandalore the Indomitable]], in one of the final [[Battle of Onderon (Great Sith War)|battles]] of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].
